description: For one product: buy_now, wait, skip, check_fit or not_enough_data, optionally for a shopper's owned device, phone platform, budget or use. With the rule, reasons with sources and status, phone fit, timing, price and what it could not answer; for an owner of the model it replaces, the /upgrade answer. display_label is the answer in the words idevice.com prints. For a line slug whose newest model is not on sale, the answer is for the newest that is, named in resolved_to. With buyer_context, buyer_decision and buyer_decision_info carry the personal answer the idevice.com decision page gives for it.

budget_usd.description: A price ceiling in US dollars

buyer_context.description: Optional. The shopper's own situation in the buyer-context-v1 grammar, set out at https://idevice.com/mcp/docs#buyer-context. A context outside it is answered with buyer_decision_info naming the fields to fix. It is used for this one answer and goes into no log.

owned_device_slug.description: product_slug of a device the shopper owns

owned_platform.description: The phone platform the shopper uses

name: should_i_buy
title: Should I buy this
